findings.source_quote: Paragraph 12: “when I awake, I shall be satisfied with His likeness.” Hymn stanza 15: “I am my Beloved’s, / And my Beloved’s mine!” and “house of wine”. Hymn stanza 19: “My Lord says, ‘Come up hither,’”.
findings.suggested_fix: Obtain approved Bengali Scripture evidence and semantic alignment for these embedded quotations before publication: Psalm 17:15, Song of Solomon 6:3 and 2:4, and Revelation 4:1. Then replace only the corresponding quotation words with the aligned approved target substrings and supply verified scripture_selections. Preserve the existing HTML, surrounding prose, poetic structure, and quotation delimiters; do not add printed references or generate fallback Scripture wording. If approved evidence remains unavailable, these quotations cannot pass the required verification.
findings.translation_quote: Paragraph 12: “যখন জাগব, তাঁর সাদৃশ্যে তৃপ্ত হব।” Stanza 15: “আমি আমার প্রিয়তমের, / আর আমার প্রিয়তম আমার!” and “দ্রাক্ষারসের ঘরে”. Stanza 19: “আমার প্রভু বলেন, ‘এখানে উঠে এসো,’”. The frozen evidence and selection audit both contain no quotation entries.
